title: 헌법연구관 등의 근무성적평정 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 3 (Appraisers)
(1) Performance appraisals shall be conducted by persons designated by the President of the Constitutional Court from among Justices of the Constitutional Court, the Secretary General, the Deputy Secretary General, the President of the Constitutional Research Institute, and Constitution Research Officers (hereinafter referred to as "appraisers").
(2) The President of the Constitutional Court may conduct an appraisal by providing an opinion concerning a person subject to appraisal.
